text:
Shahd se zyada meethi aur doodh se zyada safed nehar: Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ghunoodgi si tari ho gayi aur daf'atan sar utha kar muskuraye, phir ya to khud Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ya logon ke is sawal par ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaise muskuraye? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujh par is waqt ek Surah utri, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bismillah-hir-Rahman-nir-Rahim parh kar is poori Surah ki tilawat ki aur farmaya jante ho ke Kausar kya hai? Logon ne kaha Allah aur Uska Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi zyada jante hain. Farmaya woh ek Jannat ki nehar hai jis par bahut bhalaai hai jo mere Rabb ne mujhe ata farmayi hai, jis par meri ummat Qayamat wale din ayegi. Is ke bartan aasman ke sitaron ki ginti ke barabar hain. Baaz log is se hataye jayenge to main kahunga ae mere Rabb! Yeh bhi mere ummati hain, to kaha jayega aap ko nahin maloom ke in logon ne aap ke baad kya kya bid'atein nikali thin. Aur hadith mein warid hua hai ke is mein do parnale aasman se girte honge. Nasai ki hadith mein hai yeh waqia masjid mein guzra, isi se aksar qariyon ka istidlal hai ke yeh Surah Madani hai aur aksar fuqaha ne is hadith se istidlal kiya hai ke Bismillah-hir-Rahman-nir-Rahim har Surah mein us ke sath hi nazil hui thi aur har Surah ki ek mustaqil aayat hai. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke mujhe Kausar inayat ki gayi hai jo ek jaari nehar hai lekin garha nahin hai, is ke dono janib moti ke khaime hain, is ki mitti khalis mushk hai, is ke kankar bhi sache moti hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Me'raj wali raat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aasman par Jannat mein is nehar ko dekha aur Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se poocha ke yeh kaunsi nehar hai? To Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya ke yeh Kausar hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko de rakhi hai. Aur is qisam ki bahut si hadithein hain aur bahut si hum ne Surah Isra ki tafsir mein bayan bhi kar di hain. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke is ka pani doodh se zyada safed hai aur shahd se zyada meetha hai jis ke kinare daraz gardan wale parinde baithe hue hain.

Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne sun kar farmaya woh parinday toh bohat hi khubsurat honge, aap ne farmaya khanay mein bhi woh bohat hi laziz hain (Ibn-e-Jarir). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Anas R.A ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke Kausar kya hai, is par aap ne yeh hadith bayan ki toh Hazrat Umar R.A ne un parindon ki nisbat yeh farmaya (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain yeh nehar jannat ke darmiyan mein hai. Ek munqata sanad se Hazrat Ayesha R.A se marwi hai ke Kausar ke pani ke girnay ki awaz jo sunna chahay woh apne dono kanon mein apni dono ungliyan daal le. Awalan toh is ki sanad theek nahin, dusray is ke ma'ani yeh hain ke is jaisi awaz aati hai na ke khaas usi ki awaz ho, Wallahu A'alam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Kausar se murad woh bhalai aur khair hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko ata farmayi hai. Abu Bishr kehte hain ke main ne Saeed bin Jubair R.H se yeh sun kar kaha ke log toh kehte hain ke yeh jannat ki ek nehar hai, toh Hazrat Saeed ne farmaya woh bhi un bhalaiyon aur khair mein se hai jo aap ko Allah ki taraf se inayat hui hain. Aur bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke is se murad bohat si khair hai, toh yeh tafsir shamil hai Hauz-e-Kausar waghera sab ko.

Kausar makhooz hai kasrat se jis se murad khair-e-kaseer hai aur isi khair-e-kaseer mein hauz-e-jannat bhi hai jaise ke bahut se mufassireen se marwi hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain duniya aur aakhirat ki bahut bahut bhalaaiyan murad hain. Ikrama farmate hain nubuwwat, Quran, sawab, aakhirat Kausar hai aur yeh bhi yaad rahe ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se Kausar ki tafseer nehar-e-Kausar se bhi marwi hai jaise ke Ibn-e-Jareer mein sanadan marwi hai ke aap ne farmaya Kausar jannat ki ek nehar hai jis ke dono kinare sona chandi hain jo yaqoot aur motiyon par beh rahi hai jis ka pani barf se zyada safed hai aur shehad se zyada meetha hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi yeh tafseer marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jareer, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah waghera mein yeh riwayat marfoo bhi aayi hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih batate hain. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek din Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ke ghar tashreef le gaye, aap us waqt ghar par na thay. Aap ki biwi sahiba jo qabeela Banu Najjar se thin unhon ne kaha ke Ya Nabi Allah (ﷺ) woh to abhi abhi aap hi ki taraf gaye hain shayad Banu Najjar mein ruk gaye hon. Aap tashreef laye, Huzoor (ﷺ) ghar mein gaye to mai sahiba ne aap ke samne maleeda rakha jo aap ne tanawul farmaya. Mai sahiba khush ho kar farmane lagin Allah Ta'ala ise juz-e-jism banaye, achha hua khud tashreef le aaye, main to hazir-e-darbar hone ka irada kar chuki thi ke aap ko hauz-e-Kausar milne ki mubarak baad doon, mujh se abhi abhi Hazrat Abu Amara ne kaha tha. Aap ne farmaya haan is hauz ki zameen yaqoot, marjan, zabarjad aur motiyon ki hai. Is ke ek raawi Haram bin Usman za'eef hain lekin waqia Hasan hai aur asal to tawatur se sabit ho chuki hai, bahut se sahaba aur tabieen waghera se sabit hai ke Kausar nehar ka naam hai. Phir irshad hai ke jaise hum ne tumhein khair-e-kaseer inayat farmayi aur aisi pur-shaukat nehar di to tum bhi sirf meri hi ibadat karo, khusoosan nafl, farz namaz aur qurbani isi Wahdahu La Shareeka Lahu ke naam ki karte raho jaise farmaya (Qul inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi Rabbil Aalameen) (Surah Al-An'am: 162). Murad qurbani se oonton ka nahr karna waghera hai. Mushrikeen sajde aur qurbaniyan Allah ke siwa auron ke naam ki karte thay to yahan hukm hua ke tum sirf Allah hi ke naam ki mukhlisana ibadatein kiya karo aur jagah hai (Wala ta'kulu mimma lam yuzkarismullahi alaihi wa innahu lafisqun wa innash-shayateena layuhoona ila awliya'ihim liyujadilukum wa in ata'tumuhum innakum lamushrikun) (Surah Al-An'am: 121).

(Al-An'am: 121) Jis janwar par Allah ka naam na liya jaye use na khao yeh toh fisq hai aur kaha gaya hai ke murad Wan-har se dayen haath ka bayen haath par namaz mein seene par rakhna hai, yahi Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ghair sahih sanad ke saath marwi hai. Hazrat Sha'bi (Rahimahullah) is lafz ki yahi tafsir karte hain. Hazrat Abu Jafar Baqir (R.H) farmate hain ke is se murad namaz ke shuru ke waqt rafa-ul-yadain karna hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke matlab yeh hai ke apne seene se Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh ho. Yeh teeno qaul Ibn-e-Jarir mein manqool hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is jagah ek bahut munkar hadith marwi hai jis mein hai ke jab yeh Surah Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utri toh aap ne farmaya: "Aye Jibraeel! Wan-har se murad kya hai jo mujhe mere Parwardigar ka hukm ho raha hai?" Toh Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya: "Is se murad qurbani nahin balkay Allah ka tumhein hukm ho raha hai ke namaz ki takbir-e-tahrima ke waqt rafa-ul-yadain karo aur ruku ke waqt bhi aur jab ruku se sar uthao tab aur jab sajda karo, yahi hamari namaz hai aur un farishton ki namaz hai jo saaton aasmanon mein hain. Har cheez ki zeenat hoti hai aur namaz ki zeenat har takbir ke waqt rafa-ul-yadain karna hai." Yeh hadith isi tarah Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Atta Khurasani (R.H) farmate hain Wan-har se murad yeh hai ke apni peeth ruku se uthao toh etidal karo aur seene ko zahir karo yani itminan hasil karo. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim, yeh sab aqwal ghareeb hain aur sahih pehla qaul hai ke murad nahr se qurbaniyon ka zibah karna hai. Isi liye Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz-e-Eid se farigh ho kar apni qurbani zibah karte thay aur farmate thay: "Jo shakhs hamari namaz parhay aur hum jaisi qurbani kare usne shar'i qurbani ki aur jis ne namaz se pehle hi janwar zibah kar liya uski qurbani nahin hui." Abu Burdah bin Niyar (R.A) ne kharay ho kar kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main ne namaz-e-Eid se pehle hi qurbani kar li yeh samajh kar ke aaj ke din gosht ki chahat hogi. Aap ne farmaya: "Bas woh toh khanay ka gosht ho gaya." Sahabi ne kaha: "Acha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ab mere paas ek bakri ka bacha hai jo mujhe do bakriyon se bhi zyada mehboob hai, kya yeh kafi hoga?" Aap ne farmaya: "Haan, tujhe toh kafi hai lekin tere baad chhay mahine ka bakri ka bacha koi aur qurbani nahin de sakta." Imam Abu Jafar bin Jarir (R.H) farmate hain theek qaul uska hai jo kehta hai ke iske mayne yeh hain ke apni tamam namazein khalis Allah hi ke liye ada kar, uske siwa kisi aur ke liye na kar. Isi tarah isi ki raah mein khoon baha, kisi aur ke naam par qurbani na kar. Iska shukr baja la jis ne tujhe yeh buzurgi di aur woh nemat di jis jaisi koi aur nemat nahin, tujhi ko uske saath khaas kiya. Yahi qaul bahut acha hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi aur Atta ka bhi yahi farman hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Tujh se aur teri taraf utri hui wahi se dushmani rakhne wala hi qillat-o-zillat wala, be-barkata aur dum-bureeda hai. Yeh aayat Aas bin Wail ke baare mein utri hai. Yeh paji jahan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka zikr sunta toh kehta: "Ise chhoro, woh dum-kata hai, uske peechay uski narina aulad nahin, uske inteqal karte hi uska naam duniya se uth jayega." Is par yeh mubarak Surah nazil hui hai. Shamr bin Atiya farmate hain ke Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ke haq mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ibn-e-Abbas waghera farmate hain Ka'ab bin Ashraf aur jamaat-e-Quraish ke baare mein yeh nazil hui hai. Bazzar mein hai ke jab Ka'ab bin Ashraf Makkah mein aaya toh Quraishiyon ne us se kaha ke aap toh inke sardar hain, aap is bacha ki taraf nahin dekhte jo apni saari qoum se alag-thalak hai aur khayal karta hai ke woh afzal hai, halankeh hum hajiyon ke ahl mein se hain, Baitullah hamare hathon mein hai, Zamzam par hamara qabza hai. Toh yeh khabees kehne laga: "Beshak tum us se behtar ho." Is par yeh aayat utri, iski sanad sahih hai. Hazrat Atta farmate hain Abu Lahab ke baare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahibzaday ka inteqal hua toh yeh bad-naseeb mushrikeen se kehne laga ke aaj ki raat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nasl kat gayi. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Ibn-e-Abbas se bhi yeh manqool hai. Aap yeh bhi farmate hain ke is se murad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka har dushman hai, jin jin ke naam liye gaye woh bhi aur jin ka zikr nahin hua woh bhi. Abtar ke mayne hain tanha. Arab ka yeh bhi muhawara hai ke jab kisi ki narina aulad mar jati toh kehte: "Abtar." Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahibzada ke inteqal par bhi unhon ne dushmani ki wajah se yahi kaha jis par yeh aayat utri. Toh matlab yeh hua ke abtar woh hai jiske marne ke baad uska naam mit jaye. In mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat bhi yahi khayal kiya tha ke unke larkay toh inteqal kar gaye, woh na rahe jin ki wajah se unke inteqal ke baad bhi unka naam rehta. Hasha-o-Kalla! Allah Ta'ala aap ka naam rehti duniya tak rakhe ga, aap ki shariat abad-ul-abad tak baqi rahe gi, aap ki itaat har ek par farz kar di gayi hai, aap ka pyara aur paak naam har ek muslim ke dil-o-zaban par hai aur Qayamat tak faza-e-aasmani mein urooj-o-iqbal ke saath goonjta rahe ga. Bahr-o-bar mein har waqt iski manadi hoti rahe gi. Allah Ta'ala aap par aur aap ki aal-o-aulad par aur azwaj-o-ashab par Qayamat tak durood-o-salam be-had-o-bakasrat bhejta rahe. Ameen. Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se uske ehsan-o-rahm se Surah Kausar ki tafsir bhi khatam hui.

Wa lillahil hamdu wal minnah.

Isi liye Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) namaz-e-Eid se farigh ho kar apni qurbani zibah karte thay aur farmate thay: "Jo shakhs hamari namaz parhay aur hum jaisi qurbani kare usne shar'i qurbani ki aur jis ne namaz se pehle hi janwar zibah kar liya uski qurbani nahin hui." Abu Burdah bin Niyar (R.A) ne kharay ho kar kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Main ne namaz-e-Eid se pehle hi qurbani kar li yeh samajh kar ke aaj ke din gosht ki chahat hogi. Aap ne farmaya: "Bas woh toh khanay ka gosht ho gaya." Sahabi ne kaha: "Acha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Ab mere paas ek bakri ka bacha hai jo mujhe do bakriyon se bhi zyada mehboob hai, kya yeh kafi hoga?" Aap ne farmaya: "Haan, tujhe toh kafi hai lekin tere baad chhay mahine ka bakri ka bacha koi aur qurbani nahin de sakta." Imam Abu Jafar bin Jarir (R.H) farmate hain theek qaul uska hai jo kehta hai ke iske mayne yeh hain ke apni tamam namazein khalis Allah hi ke liye ada kar, uske siwa kisi aur ke liye na kar. Isi tarah isi ki raah mein khoon baha, kisi aur ke naam par qurbani na kar. Iska shukr baja la jis ne tujhe yeh buzurgi di aur woh nemat di jis jaisi koi aur nemat nahin, tujhi ko uske saath khaas kiya. Yahi qaul bahut acha hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi aur Atta ka bhi yahi farman hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke aye Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Tujh se aur teri taraf utri hui wahi se dushmani rakhne wala hi qillat-o-zillat wala, be-barkata aur dum-bureeda hai. Yeh aayat Aas bin Wail ke baare mein utri hai. Yeh paji jahan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka zikr sunta toh kehta: "Ise chhoro, woh dum-kata hai, uske peechay uski narina aulad nahin, uske inteqal karte hi uska naam duniya se uth jayega." Is par yeh mubarak Surah nazil hui hai. Shamr bin Atiya farmate hain ke Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ke haq mein yeh aayat utri hai. Ibn-e-Abbas waghera farmate hain Ka'ab bin Ashraf aur jamaat-e-Quraish ke baare mein yeh nazil hui hai. Bazzar mein hai ke jab Ka'ab bin Ashraf Makkah mein aaya toh Quraishiyon ne us se kaha ke aap toh inke sardar hain, aap is bacha ki taraf nahin dekhte jo apni saari qoum se alag-thalak hai aur khayal karta hai ke woh afzal hai, halankeh hum hajiyon ke ahl mein se hain, Baitullah hamare hathon mein hai, Zamzam par hamara qabza hai. Toh yeh khabees kehne laga: "Beshak tum us se behtar ho." Is par yeh aayat utri, iski sanad sahih hai. Hazrat Atta farmate hain Abu Lahab ke baare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahibzaday ka inteqal hua toh yeh bad-naseeb mushrikeen se kehne laga ke aaj ki raat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nasl kat gayi. Is par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari. Ibn-e-Abbas se bhi yeh manqool hai. Aap yeh bhi farmate hain ke is se murad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka har dushman hai, jin jin ke naam liye gaye woh bhi aur jin ka zikr nahin hua woh bhi. Abtar ke mayne hain tanha. Arab ka yeh bhi muhawara hai ke jab kisi ki narina aulad mar jati toh kehte: "Abtar." Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sahibzada ke inteqal par bhi unhon ne dushmani ki wajah se yahi kaha jis par yeh aayat utri. Toh matlab yeh hua ke abtar woh hai jiske marne ke baad uska naam mit jaye. In mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat bhi yahi khayal kiya tha ke unke larkay toh inteqal kar gaye, woh na rahe jin ki wajah se unke inteqal ke baad bhi unka naam rehta. Hasha-o-Kalla! Allah Ta'ala aap ka naam rehti duniya tak rakhe ga, aap ki shariat abad-ul-abad tak baqi rahe gi, aap ki itaat har ek par farz kar di gayi hai, aap ka pyara aur paak naam har ek muslim ke dil-o-zaban par hai aur Qayamat tak faza-e-aasmani mein urooj-o-iqbal ke saath goonjta rahe ga. Bahr-o-bar mein har waqt iski manadi hoti rahe gi. Allah Ta'ala aap par aur aap ki aal-o-aulad par aur azwaj-o-ashab par Qayamat tak durood-o-salam be-had-o-bakasrat bhejta rahe. Ameen. Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se uske ehsan-o-rahm se Surah Kausar ki tafsir bhi khatam hui.

Wa lillahil hamdu wal minnah.

Shahd se zyada meethi aur doodh se zyada safed nehar: Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ghunoodgi si tari ho gayi aur daf'atan sar utha kar muskuraye, phir ya to khud Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ya logon ke is sawal par ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kaise muskuraye? To Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujh par is waqt ek Surah utri, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Bismillah-hir-Rahman-nir-Rahim parh kar is poori Surah ki tilawat ki aur farmaya jante ho ke Kausar kya hai? Logon ne kaha Allah aur Uska Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi zyada jante hain. Farmaya woh ek Jannat ki nehar hai jis par bahut bhalaai hai jo mere Rabb ne mujhe ata farmayi hai, jis par meri ummat Qayamat wale din ayegi. Is ke bartan aasman ke sitaron ki ginti ke barabar hain. Baaz log is se hataye jayenge to main kahunga ae mere Rabb! Yeh bhi mere ummati hain, to kaha jayega aap ko nahin maloom ke in logon ne aap ke baad kya kya bid'atein nikali thin. Aur hadith mein warid hua hai ke is mein do parnale aasman se girte honge. Nasai ki hadith mein hai yeh waqia masjid mein guzra, isi se aksar qariyon ka istidlal hai ke yeh Surah Madani hai aur aksar fuqaha ne is hadith se istidlal kiya hai ke Bismillah-hir-Rahman-nir-Rahim har Surah mein us ke sath hi nazil hui thi aur har Surah ki ek mustaqil aayat hai. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya ke mujhe Kausar inayat ki gayi hai jo ek jaari nehar hai lekin garha nahin hai, is ke dono janib moti ke khaime hain, is ki mitti khalis mushk hai, is ke kankar bhi sache moti hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Me'raj wali raat Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aasman par Jannat mein is nehar ko dekha aur Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se poocha ke yeh kaunsi nehar hai? To Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya ke yeh Kausar hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko de rakhi hai. Aur is qisam ki bahut si hadithein hain aur bahut si hum ne Surah Isra ki tafsir mein bayan bhi kar di hain. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke is ka pani doodh se zyada safed hai aur shahd se zyada meetha hai jis ke kinare daraz gardan wale parinde baithe hue hain.

Hazrat Siddiq R.A ne sun kar farmaya woh parinday toh bohat hi khubsurat honge, aap ne farmaya khanay mein bhi woh bohat hi laziz hain (Ibn-e-Jarir). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Anas R.A ne Huzoor ﷺ se sawal kiya ke Kausar kya hai, is par aap ne yeh hadith bayan ki toh Hazrat Umar R.A ne un parindon ki nisbat yeh farmaya (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A farmati hain yeh nehar jannat ke darmiyan mein hai. Ek munqata sanad se Hazrat Ayesha R.A se marwi hai ke Kausar ke pani ke girnay ki awaz jo sunna chahay woh apne dono kanon mein apni dono ungliyan daal le. Awalan toh is ki sanad theek nahin, dusray is ke ma'ani yeh hain ke is jaisi awaz aati hai na ke khaas usi ki awaz ho, Wallahu A'alam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke Kausar se murad woh bhalai aur khair hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko ata farmayi hai. Abu Bishr kehte hain ke main ne Saeed bin Jubair R.H se yeh sun kar kaha ke log toh kehte hain ke yeh jannat ki ek nehar hai, toh Hazrat Saeed ne farmaya woh bhi un bhalaiyon aur khair mein se hai jo aap ko Allah ki taraf se inayat hui hain. Aur bhi Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marwi hai ke is se murad bohat si khair hai, toh yeh tafsir shamil hai Hauz-e-Kausar waghera sab ko.

Kausar makhooz hai kasrat se jis se murad khair-e-kaseer hai aur isi khair-e-kaseer mein hauz-e-jannat bhi hai jaise ke bahut se mufassireen se marwi hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain duniya aur aakhirat ki bahut bahut bhalaaiyan murad hain. Ikrama farmate hain nubuwwat, Quran, sawab, aakhirat Kausar hai aur yeh bhi yaad rahe ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se Kausar ki tafseer nehar-e-Kausar se bhi marwi hai jaise ke Ibn-e-Jareer mein sanadan marwi hai ke aap ne farmaya Kausar jannat ki ek nehar hai jis ke dono kinare sona chandi hain jo yaqoot aur motiyon par beh rahi hai jis ka pani barf se zyada safed hai aur shehad se zyada meetha hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) se bhi yeh tafseer marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jareer, Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah waghera mein yeh riwayat marfoo bhi aayi hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih batate hain. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek din Hazrat Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib (R.A) ke ghar tashreef le gaye, aap us waqt ghar par na thay. Aap ki biwi sahiba jo qabeela Banu Najjar se thin unhon ne kaha ke Ya Nabi Allah (ﷺ) woh to abhi abhi aap hi ki taraf gaye hain shayad Banu Najjar mein ruk gaye hon. Aap tashreef laye, Huzoor (ﷺ) ghar mein gaye to mai sahiba ne aap ke samne maleeda rakha jo aap ne tanawul farmaya. Mai sahiba khush ho kar farmane lagin Allah Ta'ala ise juz-e-jism banaye, achha hua khud tashreef le aaye, main to hazir-e-darbar hone ka irada kar chuki thi ke aap ko hauz-e-Kausar milne ki mubarak baad doon, mujh se abhi abhi Hazrat Abu Amara ne kaha tha. Aap ne farmaya haan is hauz ki zameen yaqoot, marjan, zabarjad aur motiyon ki hai. Is ke ek raawi Haram bin Usman za'eef hain lekin waqia Hasan hai aur asal to tawatur se sabit ho chuki hai, bahut se sahaba aur tabieen waghera se sabit hai ke Kausar nehar ka naam hai. Phir irshad hai ke jaise hum ne tumhein khair-e-kaseer inayat farmayi aur aisi pur-shaukat nehar di to tum bhi sirf meri hi ibadat karo, khusoosan nafl, farz namaz aur qurbani isi Wahdahu La Shareeka Lahu ke naam ki karte raho jaise farmaya (Qul inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi Rabbil Aalameen) (Surah Al-An'am: 162). Murad qurbani se oonton ka nahr karna waghera hai. Mushrikeen sajde aur qurbaniyan Allah ke siwa auron ke naam ki karte thay to yahan hukm hua ke tum sirf Allah hi ke naam ki mukhlisana ibadatein kiya karo aur jagah hai (Wala ta'kulu mimma lam yuzkarismullahi alaihi wa innahu lafisqun wa innash-shayateena layuhoona ila awliya'ihim liyujadilukum wa in ata'tumuhum innakum lamushrikun) (Surah Al-An'am: 121).

(Al-An'am: 121) Jis janwar par Allah ka naam na liya jaye use na khao yeh toh fisq hai aur kaha gaya hai ke murad Wan-har se dayen haath ka bayen haath par namaz mein seene par rakhna hai, yahi Hazrat Ali (R.A) se ghair sahih sanad ke saath marwi hai. Hazrat Sha'bi (Rahimahullah) is lafz ki yahi tafsir karte hain. Hazrat Abu Jafar Baqir (R.H) farmate hain ke is se murad namaz ke shuru ke waqt rafa-ul-yadain karna hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke matlab yeh hai ke apne seene se Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh ho. Yeh teeno qaul Ibn-e-Jarir mein manqool hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is jagah ek bahut munkar hadith marwi hai jis mein hai ke jab yeh Surah Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par utri toh aap ne farmaya: "Aye Jibraeel! Wan-har se murad kya hai jo mujhe mere Parwardigar ka hukm ho raha hai?" Toh Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya: "Is se murad qurbani nahin balkay Allah ka tumhein hukm ho raha hai ke namaz ki takbir-e-tahrima ke waqt rafa-ul-yadain karo aur ruku ke waqt bhi aur jab ruku se sar uthao tab aur jab sajda karo, yahi hamari namaz hai aur un farishton ki namaz hai jo saaton aasmanon mein hain. Har cheez ki zeenat hoti hai aur namaz ki zeenat har takbir ke waqt rafa-ul-yadain karna hai." Yeh hadith isi tarah Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi hai.
